title: Parho La Illaha Illallah
body:
Koh Muhammed Pak Rasoolallah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ohnu Rulkay Mariyan Shaamiyan Nay (x2)  Jida Nana Dai Parda Sun Kalma.
<<DIVIDER>>
Oh Saara Mulk Naamazi Si, Paar Rab Na Una Tai Razi Si (x2)
Bay Deen Utha Sab Qazi Si (x2) Dita Aal-e-Rasool Tai Fatwa La.
<<DIVIDER>>
Lai Veeran Meriyan Saravai, Tenu Ro Ro Vaajay Mara Iai (x2)
Abid Hath Puriyan Muhara Way (x2) Menu Wekh Kai Ronda Shaam Da Rai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Beta Ali Da Nabhi Da Nawasa Si, Odhai Hath Vich Deen Da Qasa Si (x2)
Tin Tin Da Yaaro Pyasa Si (x2) Taati Rait Tay Roleya Deen Da Shah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Veeran Ve Apna Nay Koiee, Beti Ali Di Karbal Vich Royi (x2)
Pardes Dai Vich Majboor Hoyi (x2) Payan Hath Karian Pur Bismillah.
<<DIVIDER>>
Jadoo Shaami Banga Milgaya, Karay Zainab Nana Rul Gayan (x2)
Sabna Diyan Sanga Hil Gaya Aan (x2) Jadoo Aya Naam Muhammed Da.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab Kesay Kahani Phol Vekho, Tusi Saab Na Kitab Nu Khol Vekho (x2)
Sab Mulka Nu Tusi Tol Vekho (x2) Nay Honay Aisa Bhain Bhira.
<<DIVIDER>>
Javaid Aai Zahra Jaiyan Nai, Gaudi Paak Rasool Khadiyan Nai (x2)
Baan Qaidi Shaam Vich Aya Nai (x2) Hai Lutlaya Ummat Nai Parda.
